text: BAM share rose 0.01 percentage points over 24 hours and 0.05 percentage points over 7 days, leaving 34.3% of all Solana stake routed through BAM. Concentration remains elevated, with the largest node at 21.8% and the node Nakamoto coefficient at 3. The 67 leadership changes should be read as whale-driven routing, not a structural rollover; only the fra event on 2026-06-24 has been validated as that pattern.
